style: PFEC-branded 'livestream announcement' sting, modeled beat-for-beat on a Jitter.video livestream-announcement template but restyled entirely in PFEC's own two-tone brand system (NOT the reference's original colors). Flat navy field, a single gold rule-bar wipe, a heavy-weight typewriter headline, a glossy chrome-shaded 3D brand-mark hero that auto-rotates, and a minimal footer lockup + CTA. Confident, corporate-tech, restrained — motion is the message, no narration. Strictly two-tone/monochrome-with-tint-ramp palette; no gradients or textures on the background. No third-party watermark of any kind (the reference had a jitter.video export badge — explicitly excluded, not part of the design).

asset_needs.note: Already-resolved local file, no search. Use ONLY the first <g> of this SVG (the abstract mark) — three parallel diagonal parallelogram bars, NOT the wordmark text groups below it. viewBox is 1200x429.3. Bar geometry (for re-derivation in the 3D build): bar 1 (fill #100694) points 103.49,18.37 / 15.96,280.03 / 146.85,280.03 / 234.37,18.37; bar 2 (fill #908EC0) points 281.78,18.37 / 194.24,280.03 / 325.14,280.03 / 412.68,18.37; bar 3 (fill #C9C9E2) points 459.87,18.37 / 372.35,280.03 / 503.24,280.03 / 590.77,18.37. Each bar is a constant-width parallelogram (top width ~130.9px = bottom width), evenly gapped (~47.4px gap top and bottom), all slanted at the same angle (horizontal shift ~87.5px over a height of ~261.7px, i.e. ~18.5deg off vertical, leaning like a forward slash). Combined mark bounding box is ~574.8 x 261.7 (~2.2:1 wide). Left-to-right tint ramp is dark->mid->light: #100694 -> #908EC0 -> #C9C9E2.

Pre-rendered full-color raster wordmark lockup for the small bottom-left footer placement — simpler than re-deriving the wordmark from SVG at small size. NOT used for the hero mark (hero mark is built from the SVG bars above, 3D-extruded).

customize.reuse_first_note: Base the piece-assembly / glow-bloom / hold-frame scaffolding on the `logo-outro` catalog block (npx hyperframes add logo-outro), then hand-author the parts it does not cover: (1) the multi-line typewriter headline with inline clock glyph + blinking cursor, (2) the glossy chrome 3D bar-motif build + continuous Y-axis auto-rotate (logo-outro's own reveal is a generic flat piece-assembly, not a shaded 3D extrusion+spin), and (3) the split two-sided footer CTA row (logo lockup left / CTA text right) in place of logo-outro's single centered tagline+URL-pill pattern. This is a hand-authored composite on top of the logo-reveal base per the module's reuse-first-for-gaps guidance.

background.treatment: flat solid fill, #100796 (PFEC navy), no gradient, no texture, no vignette

rule_bar.description: a thin horizontal rule bar wipes in left-to-right near the upper third of the frame, above where the headline block will sit
rule_bar.motion_primitive: bar_wipe (motion-vocabulary 'Accent graphics') — fromTo({scaleX:0},{scaleX:1}, transformOrigin:'left center', duration ~0.5s, ease power3.out)
rule_bar.hold: stays on screen static for the rest of the piece once wiped in

headline.gap_note: HAND-AUTHOR — no catalog caption-* block covers a 3-line sequential typewriter with a trailing blinking cursor and an inline icon glyph; build directly per the `typewriter` primitive in motion-vocabulary.md (reveal via clip/width step), one line at a time.
headline.alignment: left, stacked under the rule bar, same left margin as the rule bar's start edge
headline.cursor: blinking vertical bar/rectangle in #FFC500 at the end of the actively-typing line only; stops/hides on that line once the next line begins typing

lines.note: render EXACTLY this bracketed placeholder text — intentionally an unfilled editable placeholder, not a resolved date

render EXACTLY this bracketed placeholder text (also intentionally unfilled). Preceded inline by a small clock/spinner icon glyph in #FFC500, sized to the line's cap-height, ~0.4em gap before the text starts typing.

headline.post_typing: by 3.0s all 3 lines sit fully typed and static; cursor blink on line 3 may continue briefly then settle/disappear by the time the hero mark lands (~4.5s) so the final hold frame (5.0s+) is clean/loopable

hero_mark.gap_note: HAND-AUTHOR — net-new. Adapt the layered-offset extrusion technique from `rules/3d-text-depth-layers` (stacked, offset, per-layer-shaded copies building a physical depth illusion) from TEXT glyphs to the 3-bar SVG shape geometry, driven via CSS 3D transforms (perspective + rotateY) rather than the rule's default 2D pixel-offset stack, so the extrusion actually reads as a rotating 3D solid, not a static drop-shadow stack.
hero_mark.source_geometry: the 3 diagonal parallelogram bars extracted from the SVG first <g> (see asset_needs[0].note for exact coordinates/proportions)
hero_mark.construction: each of the 3 bars becomes an extruded 3D slab: a front face + back face + connecting side faces (CSS 3D transform 'panels', e.g. 4-6 stacked depth layers per bar per the depth-layers rule, or true front/back/side quad faces if the Builder prefers a proper cuboid) — front face is the flat colored bar, extrusion depth faces get a darker shaded tone of the same bar's hue to sell volume
hero_mark.tint_ramp: left-to-right across the 3 bars: bar 1 = #100694 (base/dark), bar 2 = #908EC0 (mid), bar 3 = #C9C9E2 (light) — matches the source SVG exactly
hero_mark.shading: glossy/chrome specular highlight — a bright diagonal highlight streak on each bar's front face (light hue near-white, low opacity, positioned along the bar's slant) plus a darker shadow edge on the trailing extrusion side, so each bar reads as a polished chrome-like slab rather than flat color
hero_mark.entrance: scale from 0 -> 1 while fading in (motion-vocabulary 'scale_grow' or 'scale_punch': from scale:0, opacity:0, duration ~0.5-0.7s, ease power2.out or back.out for a touch of glossy weight), landing by ~3.6-3.8s within the 3.0-4.5s window
hero_mark.post_entrance: once landed, begins a continuous slow Y-axis auto-rotate loop (rotateY 0deg -> 360deg, ~8-12s per full revolution, linear/no-ease, looping) that keeps spinning uninterrupted through the rest of the piece — this is the hero visual anchor and the only element still animating during the final hold
hero_mark.position: centered horizontally, positioned below the headline text block, roughly the visual midpoint of the remaining vertical space above the footer row
hero_mark.size: scaled to a comfortable hero size for the 1080-wide canvas given the mark's ~2.2:1 aspect ratio (e.g. target width in the ~700-820px range at full canvas width 1080px, leaving side margins) — not full-bleed

footer.gap_note: HAND-AUTHOR — logo-outro's own footer is a single centered tagline+URL pill; this design needs a two-sided split row instead.
footer.layout: bottom row, safe margin ~64-80px from the bottom and side edges of the 1080x1920 canvas

right.content: CTA line: "Learn more — link in bio"
right.color: #FFC500 or #FFFFFF (Builder's call for best contrast/read against the navy footer zone)
right.font: Poppins, a lighter/regular weight than the headline (footer text is secondary, not another hero moment)

footer.motion_primitive: slide_bottom + fade_in on both halves together (motion-vocabulary: from y:+150, opacity:0, ease power4.out, duration ~0.5s), landing by ~5.0s

hold.description: resting/loop-able state on the fully-built frame: rule bar static, all 3 headline lines fully typed (cursor settled/hidden), hero 3D mark continuing its auto-rotate loop, footer fully in place. No new elements enter after 5.0s — only the mark's rotation continues, so the tail can loop cleanly back to a near-identical frame.

customize.no_watermark: do not render any tool/export watermark (e.g. no 'jitter.video'-style badge) anywhere in the frame at any beat

content.url_note: No literal URL pill in this design — the footer CTA line ('Learn more — link in bio') stands in for it per the brief; do not fabricate a URL.
